parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The client ID. When deleting a backup snapshot of ECS File Backup Essential Edition, you must specify either this parameter or **InstanceId**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ECS instance ID. When deleting a backup snapshot of ECS File Backup Essential Edition, you must specify either this parameter or **ClientId**.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The backup source type. Valid values:

* **ECS_FILE**: backup snapshot of ECS File Backup Essential Edition.
* **OSS**: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud OSS.
* **NAS**: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud NAS.
* **UDM_ECS**: backup snapshot of an entire ECS instance.
